subject: gk
question:
Which of the following statements is/are correct about the neighbouring countries of India?

(A) India supported Maldives in 2022 with a grant of nearly $4 billion to support the dwindling economy.

(B) India has the highest GDP in dollar terms as compared to Sri Lanka, Bhutan and Bangladesh.
solution:
Correct Answer **Only B**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****​​Important Current Affairs on India's GDP Growth in 2022:**

 
• The International Monetary Fund (IMF) on 11th Oct 2022 slashed India's economic growth forecast to 6.8% for 2022.
 
• The World Bank on 6th Oct 2022 cut its 2022-23 (FY23) real gross domestic product (GDP) growth forecast for India to 6.5%, from an earlier estimate of 7.5%.
 
• Rating agency ICRA has maintained its forecast of 7.2% growth in India's GDP for the financial year FY23.
 
• SBI has revised India's full-year GDP growth forecast to 6.8% for the financial year FY23. Earlier, the growth forecast was 7.5%.
 
• On the International Monetary Fund (IMF) on 26 July 2022 slashed India's economic outlook for the financial year 2022-23 from 8.2 to 7.4%.
 
• Morgan Stanley has trimmed India's economic growth forecast by 50 basis points to 7.9% for the fiscal year 2022-23.
 
• Global growth is expected to decelerate "markedly" to 4.1% in 2022 from 5.5% in 2021 and drop further to 3.2% in 2023.
 
• As per the National Statistical Office (NSO) report released on 7 January 2022, India's Gross domestic product (GDP) is expected to grow at 9.2 per cent in the fiscal year 2021-22.
